slides.title:
One context is
one opinion
slides.body: A single agent writes the code, then grades its own work. It defends its first idea to the end of the context window — the same trap that makes authors bad reviewers of their own code.

slides.title: When to reach for it
items: The task splits along clean seams

slides.sub: Parallel agents don't just finish sooner. They disagree — and the disagreement is the signal.

slides.quote: “An agent reviewing its own work is one opinion counted twice.”
